history.prompt:
A closed matte black ledger notebook with a plain cover and a brass pen lying beside it on a dark desk, one small brass paperclip on the cover, warm brass light from the upper left. Everything sits in the lower half of the frame; the upper 45% is empty ground. Shot straight from above. No printed or written text anywhere.

Visual style: calm, precise, premium, quiet confidence. A matte near-black ground (#121515) with fine film grain, lit by one soft warm brass-toned light source. Palette: near-black, mist white (#F4F9F9), deep ink-blue (#0C2027), warm brass tones and at most ONE small gold (#F5C13A) accent. Large areas of deliberate empty negative space so text can be placed on top later. Flat, restrained, editorial. Avoid: neon, lens flare, glossy 3D blobs, cyber grids, circuit boards, rockets, light bulbs, handshakes, stock-photo people, faces, hands, fake UI, charts, and any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks in the image.
